tspan.tspan: Data Source: External system(s) providing raw electricity/load data.
Data Layer: Local persisted datasets (raw, processed, marts), tracked/versioned where needed.
Config Layer: Runtime, SQL, auth, and training configuration consumed by services and pipelines.
Orchestration: Airflow coordinates pipeline steps and schedules workflows.
Airflow Metadata DB (Postgres): Stores DAG/task state, logs metadata, users, and scheduler metadata. It is required by Airflow, but is a separate service.
Data Services: Ingestion, preprocessing, marts, and later feature engineering jobs that transform data.
Model Services: Training now; inference can be added later as a dedicated online serving component.
API Layer: FastAPI endpoints serving data and model outputs to clients and UI routes.
Frontend Delivery: UI/static assets exposed via API and reverse proxy path routing.
Reverse Proxy (Nginx): Single entrypoint, routes requests to API, Airflow, MLflow, Grafana, Prometheus, and other internal services.
Prometheus: Time-series metrics collector and query engine (scrapes targets, stores metrics).
Node Exporter: Host-level metrics target (CPU, memory, disk, network). Scraped by Prometheus.
cAdvisor: Container-level metrics target. Scraped by Prometheus.
Alertmanager: Alert routing and notification engine. Receives fired alerts from Prometheus.
Grafana: Visualization and dashboards for Prometheus (and other datasources if configured).
MLflow: Experiment tracking and model artifact metadata for training lifecycle.
Model Registry/Artifacts: Persisted trained models, parameters, and related metadata.
